snippet.title: A new style direction for #LittleShore 🌙 | #showcase
snippet.description:
Little Shore | A Visual Overhaul!

Little Shore has been getting quite the makeover!

I've been working on a visual overhaul, from the post-processing and atmosphere to a completely redesigned UI.

The goal was to give Little Shore a stronger identity, leaning further into its cosy, Celtic-inspired world with a touch of Burtonesque whimsy.

What's changed?

Reworked post-processing, lighting and atmosphere

A new, handcrafted UI inspired by Celtic and pagan aesthetics

Improved colours and visual consistency

A more cohesive look across the world and its menus

Little Shore is a relaxing little god game where you sculpt islands, build settlements, nurture your Wee Folk and uncover forgotten mysteries. No combat, no timers, just your own wee corner of the world.

Play Little Shore on itch.io:
https://redcat-noodle.itch.io/little-shore

Made by RedCat_Noodle, a solo indie developer.

#LittleShore #IndieGame #SoloDev #GodGame #GameDev #IndieDev #CozyGames #CelticFantasy
